newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Viral announces private placement.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Viral announces private placement.

text.p: Advanced Viral Research Corp said Tuesday it completed a private placement in the form of a 7 percent ten year convertible debenture to the RBB Bank of Austria.
The debenture is convertible into shares of common stock at 70 percent of the average closing prices for the five consecutive trading days before the conversion date, Advanced Viral said.

In addition, the company said it issued to RBB Bank warrants to purchase an aggregate of 535,134 common shares (about 2/10 of one percent of outstanding shares) at prices ranging from $0.29 to $0.84 per share, in an offshore transaction.
The company said the financing, in the amount of $1 million, will be used to help fund its ongoing research and development programs for its drug RETICULOSE.
